research_question: Private-credit funds piloting on-chain settlement: what operational and disclosure risks matter for LP reporting?
audience: Private-credit GP ops/compliance and LP due-diligence readers.
scope: Original-condition retest: reuse 2026-10-14 synthetic pack (charter, compliance issues, LP questionnaire, 90-day metrics). No live web. Change=Lite→Full+independent review requirement.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): risk map, evidence bounds, counter-evidence, disclosure (admin NAV vs on-chain). Registries/checklist separate.
depth: Full long-form finance/tech memo with formal review tier; not a crypto product pitch.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources only; do not treat pilot success as production readiness; disclose synthetic; if independent backend unavailable, label same-session review and do not claim independence.
